{{Top|leg}}
'''Sleep-generating fields''' were used at the [[Kessel prison|prison facilities]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] under [[Moruth Doole]]'s rule. The fields forced the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] workers to sleep, and caused fitful nightmares. The sleep-generating fields were part of Doole's efforts to reduce prisoner escape attempts.
